metadata.label: Koigen–Tjuvholmen waterfront footpath (modeled demo)
metadata.modeled_scenario_note: The notice confirms a waterfront footpath closure and a signed diversion, but does not confirm this candidate segment or the calculated route.
unknowns: The notice does not establish the exact footpath closure extent; OSM way 112510399 between nodes 302372908 and 1023215093 is only a modeled candidate section.
The exact start date, end date and duration of the footpath closure are not stated in the notice; the workspace assessment date is only a model input.
Slope, surface and steps are not established by the saved sanitized OSM map data and remain unknown.
The 593 m route is a modeled detour on the saved walking graph, not the municipality's signed diversion or a measured on-site route.

evidence.status: Modeled candidate endpoints; exact closure extent is unknown.
